slot: Default deploy stack (SaaS + API + MCP server)

pick.name: Cloudflare Workers + Neon + Better Auth + R2 + Resend + Sentry + PostHog
pick.what: One TS monorepo: web app (Workers static/SSR), API (Hono on Workers), remote MCP server (createMcpHandler + Workers OAuth Provider), Postgres on Neon, auth via Better Auth, files on R2
pick.why: Every piece has a commercial-OK free tier, typed SDKs Claude Code knows, and no lock-in at the data layer (Postgres, S3 API)
pick.free_limits: $0 until: >100k req/day or >10 ms CPU (Workers Paid $5); >1 GB/project or need PITR (Neon Launch, usage-based); >100 emails/day (Resend Pro $20); >5k errors or 2nd user (Sentry Team $26); >1M events (PostHog pay-go with caps); >5 crons or >10k queue ops/day (Workers Paid)
pick.install: npm create cloudflare@latest; npx neonctl@latest init; npm i better-auth resend @sentry/cloudflare posthog-js

alts.name: Container path: Cloud Run + Neon + Better Auth
alts.what: Same stack but Docker on Cloud Run
alts.why: For Python/FastAPI agents or long requests
alts.free_limits: Cloud Run free 2M req/180k vCPU-s; card required

alts.name: Vercel Pro + Neon + Better Auth
alts.why: If you want first-party Next.js and pay $20/mo from day one

candidates.name: Vercel Pro variant
candidates.verdict: Alt if paying from day one

candidates.name: Oracle VM + Coolify
candidates.verdict: All self-hosted; most ops; good for internal tools

decision: Use the Workers stack by default; move individual services to Cloud Run when they need Python or long CPU, and pay Workers $5/mo as the first upgrade since it lifts CPU, cron, queue and log limits at once. For HIPAA/PHI workloads none of these free tiers should hold PHI; budget for BAA-capable paid plans before signing a healthcare client.
note: Consolidated: Next.js apps run here through @opennextjs/cloudflare (Next.js 16.2.3+). The MCP server, the API and your personal site share one free Workers quota of 100k requests a day, so move to Workers Paid ($5/mo) or split accounts once traffic grows. No plan in this stack carries a HIPAA BAA; see the HIPAA slot before touching PHI.
details: Card checkout must be a hosted/overlay MoR page: Cloudflare Self-Serve Subscription Agreement s.2.2.1(h) forbids processing or collecting credit-card data on any web property receiving Free Services. Sentry: use @sentry/cloudflare (wizard -i nextjs only if you actually use Next.js).

verify.note: The ToS claim is confirmed: Cloudflare Self-Serve Subscription Agreement s.2.2.1(h) forbids 'process or collect personal or business credit card information on any web property that is receiving Free Services' (Free Services are defined in s.2.6). A hosted or overlay MoR checkout is fine. The upgrade triggers are correct. The install line uses posthog-js and @sentry/cloudflare, but the error-monitoring slot's install uses the Next.js wizard, which conflicts with the stack's Vite-framework advice.
